doc.description: Receives marker sets from an OptiTrack system (NatNet) and shows a convex hull of each selected object in the GCS (SHAPE message).
doc.usage: usage: display_objects.py [-h] -n NAME -r REF [-c COLOR] [-sn] [-t TIMEOUT] [-th THRESHOLD] [-b IVY_BUS] [-s SERVER] [-m MULTICAST] [-dp DATA_PORT] [-cp COMMAND_PORT] [-v] [-vv] [-f FREQ] [-rp REFRESH_PERIOD] [-up {y_up,z_up}] [-o]

option.description: Regular expression of the names of the object to display
Reference position in lat,long format in degrees
Display the name of the object
Timeout for removing object from scene
Threshold distance to consider a moving object in meter
NatNet server data socket UDP port
NatNet server command socket UDP port
display debug messages and optitrack debug messages
refresh period at which message is sent event if the object is not moving
Optitrack Up axis: y_up or z_up.
